name: Kids' Activities
description: Every kid's season in one place — practices, games, and rehearsals with times and locations, coach contacts, and the gear checklist so nothing gets left behind.

activities.sql: SELECT id, member_id, name, season, location, coach_name, coach_contact, notes, emoji, archived, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM app_kids_activities__activities WHERE archived = 0 ORDER BY created_at

sessions.sql: SELECT id, activity_id, kind, session_date, start_time, end_time, location, notes, created_by, created_at FROM app_kids_activities__sessions ORDER BY session_date, start_time LIMIT 600

gear.sql: SELECT g.id, g.activity_id, g.name, g.sort_order, g.created_by, g.created_at FROM app_kids_activities__gear g JOIN app_kids_activities__activities a ON a.id = g.activity_id AND a.archived = 0 ORDER BY g.sort_order, g.created_at

source.query: SELECT s.id AS id, a.name AS title, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.location, ''), a.location) AS subtitle, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.start_time, ''), s.session_date) AS when_at, a.member_id AS member_id FROM app_kids_activities__sessions s JOIN app_kids_activities__activities a ON a.id = s.activity_id AND a.archived = 0 WHERE s.session_date = :today ORDER BY s.start_time LIMIT 20

SELECT a.name AS title, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.location, ''), a.location) AS subtitle FROM app_kids_activities__sessions s JOIN app_kids_activities__activities a ON a.id = s.activity_id AND a.archived = 0 WHERE s.session_date >= :today ORDER BY s.session_date, s.start_time LIMIT 3
